primary_gt.interpretation: The conservative ledger supports a rainfall-saturation slope-failure and flash-flood diagnosis for Sao Sebastiao.

provenance.notes: Ground truth is generated from the locked event dates and the report rainfall and image-date statements.

criteria.name: final_ledger_state
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for the combined rainfall-saturation outcome without the pass count, or 1 point for a vague heavy-rain label without the ledger state.

criteria.name: extracted_event_anchors
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct anchor; give no credit for replacing the lower bound with unrelated gridded values.

criteria.description: Computes 4 inclusive days, 170.0 mm/day, and 1.36 threshold multiple with correct units or field names.
criteria.name: rainfall_formula_values
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points if only one derived rainfall value is correct, or 1 point if formulas are stated but arithmetic is wrong.

criteria.description: Computes the 7-day post-image lag and applies the <= 10 days threshold.
criteria.name: post_image_timing_logic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1.5 points for the correct lag without the threshold result, or 1 point for recognizing post-storm timing with the wrong day count.

criteria.description: Evaluates all four ledger checks using the specified inequalities.
criteria.name: threshold_check_application
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.75 point for each correctly evaluated check.

criteria.description: Returns valid compact JSON and keeps the interpretation tied to the computed rainfall and timing ledger.
criteria.name: compact_interpretation_and_json
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if the JSON is mostly usable but verbose, or if the interpretation is plausible but not clearly tied to the computed checks.
